bibl.title: Vedāntasiddhāntasūktimañjarī
bibl.note: Thangaswami, R. A Bibliographical Survey of Advaita Vedānta Literature. Madras: Rathnam Press, 1980.
It has 250 verses and a commentary called Prakāśa. See New Catalogus Catalogorum (NCC). Vols 1–36: vol. 5, p. 207a

This work contains the essence of Appaya Dīkṣita's Siddhāntaleśa. It is divided into 4 sections: Samanvaya, Avirodha, Sādhana, and Phala. SeeThangaswami, R. A Bibliographical Survey of Advaita Vedānta Literature. Madras: Rathnam Press, 1980: p. 334.
